[DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Mon 19:17): Reaktion zur Berlin-Wahl | Wirtschaft zu Vergesellschaftung | Bilanz Bezahlkarte
item.description:
Originally published Mon 21 Sep 2026 19:17 IDT.
Die Linke hat bei der Berlin-Wahl auch einst grüne Hochburgen erobern können, etwa den Bezirk Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg. Dort ging kein einziges Direktmandat und keine einzige Zweitstimme an die Grünen. Reporter Hari Sas hat Stimmen vor Ort gesammelt. Außerdem: Wohnungswirtschaft zu Vergesellschaftung. Bürgermeisterwahl in Strausberg. Bilanz zur Bezahlkarte.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Mon 18:27): Typhoon hits Japan causing landslides and cancelled flights
item.description:
Originally published Mon 21 Sep 2026 18:27 IDT.

A powerful typhoon passing Japan's east coast is bringing heavy rainfall and major disruption. More than 1.9 million people in and around Tokyo have been told to evacuate. Winds from Typhoon Dujuan have caused power cuts for thousands of people, and hundreds of flights have been cancelled. Large events - including the Asian Games and Tokyo Game Show - have been postponed or called off.

Also in this podcast: Nearly 500 people have been arrested in a major transatlantic operation targeting criminal gangs; officials in Gaza have announced plans to demolish more than 250 buildings; Vladimir Putin's political party is on course to retain its majority in Russia's parliamentary elections; a new trial aims to help dementia patients remain in their own homes and out of care facilities; and how arguments over sunbeds on European beaches have turned deadly.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world.
